title_as_printed: Experimental density differences for NaCl(aq) and deviations {absolute, delta Delta rho; weighted, delta_w Delta rho = delta Delta rho / sigma(Delta rho)} from the cubic-spline surface: m0 = 1 mol kg^-1; rho0 = 1 kg m^-3

footnotes_as_printed.a: These values were not included in the least-squares fit because of systematic differences from the rest of the results. See text for discussion.

pressure_note: pressure of the flow system read on an in-line test gauge (0.3 MPa accuracy set I, 0.1 MPa set II); absolute or gauge not stated

value.what: density of NaCl(aq) minus density of pure water at the same T and p (relative vibrating-tube densimeter, water reference); rho0 = 1 kg m^-3 so printed number is in kg m^-3

skip_rows.reason: label rows 'Set I' and 'Set II' (two independent series of measurements)

extra_unmapped: delta(Delta rho)/rho0 (absolute deviation from the authors' cubic-spline surface, kg m^-3, derived)
notes: Printed layout is two side-by-side column groups per page with the same headers; they are written as one long table, left group top to bottom then right group, page by page (journal pp. 954-958). Rows 1-280 are Set I (T 323-597 K, pressures 0.1-40 MPa, 2 decimals in Delta rho), rows 282-444 are Set II (T 322-550 K, 3 decimals in Delta rho, m given to 5-6 digits). Footnote a (not used in the fit) is printed on the last column of nine rows at 548.05 K, 24.58-24.72 MPa; recorded in the note column. Printed oddities kept as is: m = 0.1016 with Delta rho = 0.99 at 597.45 K, 20.65 MPa (all neighbouring rows at that state give 0.0564, 0.1051, ...; 0.1016 is probably a misprint for 0.0106, which is the molality used in the 38.58 MPa block); 'delta_w Delta rho' printed as 0.05 (two decimals) at 323.16 K, 20.24 MPa, 5.0464; m 5.0460 (not 5.0464) at 548.05 K, 24.72 MPa. Table 1 (calibration constants), Tables 3-7 (spline knots, Debye-Hueckel coefficients, spline-generated recommended values) are not extracted.

row_held.reason: m printed 0.1016 at 597.45 K, 20.65 MPa; neighbours imply 0.0102-0.0106; likely misprint of 0.0106; held (mapping audit 2026-10-02)
